jupyterlite-desc: Serves a JupyterLite sandbox from the wiki's own origin, so in-browser Python can use the reader's existing wiki session.
apierror-jupyterlite-disabled: The JupyterLite sandbox is not enabled on this wiki.
apihelp-jupyterliteconfig-description: Return this wiki's default configuration for the in-browser notebook agent.
jupyterlite-portlet-tooltip: Open a Python notebook that runs in your browser and can read and write this wiki as you
jupyterlite-open-notebook-tooltip: Open this notebook in the in-browser Python sandbox
jupyterlite-notebook-missing: This notebook could not be found on the wiki.
